reason: A DSH settings plugin for searching, reviewing, and installing third-party DSH plugins and curated solution packs, with agent tools and consent-gated installation workflows.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中浏览、搜索、审核并安装第三方插件及精选解决方案包。
summaries.en: Browse, review, and install third-party DSH plugins and curated solution packs from the DSH Settings UI.

capabilities: browses a static catalog of DSH plugins
displays plugin metadata and install eligibility evidence
installs third-party plugins into a DSH profile
can execute reviewed package lifecycle scripts after explicit consent
modifies profile manifests, lockfiles, and workspace configuration
provides agent-callable search, detail, install, and manual-guide tools
